ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white lobes on the lateral segments. A large, low-intensity dark contiguous region originates from the central peduncle area and radiates toward the trailing edges. Numerous low-intensity spots and mottling are visible on the interior of both white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Right lobe displays larger amplitude peaks near the tip; left lobe shows a more consistent, finer-grain jagged boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge sweeping upward to sharp distal tips, with a multi-curvated trailing edge that transitions from convex at the tips to concave near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of low-intensity, high-contrast dark pixel formations located at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized tissue irregularities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical linear pixel disruption on the left lobe; several shorter, diagonal rake-like marks visible on the lower right lobe segment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark linear scar/mark on the left lobe surface; significant irregular texture and dark pigmentation at the fluke tips.
